messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 ALERT: canary 'canary-usw2-embed' failing — failure_rate=22% over 5m, RTT spike, paging @oncall (Jordan)
Jordan: on it. looking at console now. first glance: spikes line up with a push to routing service ~10:42UTC?
Jordan: console -> top traces show 503s from routing in us-west-2, not model host oom. customer-facing error rate ~0.6% overall but 4-6% for a small shard.
Priya: can confirm a config rollout to routing 10:41 by infra-cicd, small traffic-split change. rolling back now in case.
Mateo: FYI this is triggering the canary alert with the current settings: interval=30s, fail_threshold=1, page_after=1. lots of noise w/ transient blips.
Jordan: rollback kicked. can we avoid paging for single-sample blips while we validate? paging is loud.
Priya: agree. will pause paging for this canary for 30m while we validate rollback. creating suppression rule.
Mateo: proposing two changes to reduce future false positives:

1) add requirement of 3 consecutive failures before page
2) increase interval to 60s to smooth transient network jitter

Jordan: makes sense. also add a 2m grace_period after deploy rollouts so rolling updates don't blow the canary alerts.
Maya: +1. also worth adding an aggregated dashboard per region + model shard so we see patterns, not single-host noise.
Mateo: I can draft the config patch now. will test in staging before applying prod.
Jordan: paste the patch here when ready. I'll own the oncall handoff to Alex in 20m.
Mateo: draft patch (staging):
```yaml
canary_name: canary-usw2-embed
interval_seconds: 60
consecutive_failures_to_alert: 3
grace_period_seconds_post_deploy: 120
alert_routing: |-
  if severity == "high" and failures_in_5m >= 3 then page oncall
  else create-ticket
```
Mateo: notes: this keeps metrics in system but avoids single-failure pages. also reduces probe churn by halving interval.
Priya: can we add an additional condition to only page if failure_rate_by_shard > 5%? that avoids paging when only 1 of 20 shards flaps.
Maya: yes, `failure_rate_by_shard > 0.05` is reasonable.
Mateo: updated patch (staging):
```yaml
consecutive_failures_to_alert: 3
min_shard_failure_rate: 0.05
```
Jordan: good. Mateo, push to staging, run 30m, if stable roll to prod with me in the loop. Priya, keep rollback in place until we confirm.
Priya: suppression rule created: `suppress:canary-usw2-embed:30m` (id:supp-7721). will delete if rollback fully resolves.
Mateo: pushed to staging and kicked off synthetic-run. tagging @sre-tooling-bot to capture metric snapshots.
sre-tooling-bot: snapshot created: metrics/canary/usw2/1864512345 -> stored in /runbooks/canary-snapshots/1864512345.json
Jordan: quick customer impact note: Engineering CS says 3 enterprise customers reported degraded latencies for a 20-min window; no data loss, primarily 5xx on a small percentage of requests.
Alex: I’m up next. if you want me to flip the prod patch once staging looks green I can take it. also will add the region+shard dashboard tile today.
Jordan: handing off in 18m. current plan: keep suppression 30m, validate rollback, test new canary policy in staging, then promote. will follow up with post-incident alert-tuning doc.
Maya: please also add an eval check to Canary CI so we don't page on deploy churn — simple: ignore failures in the first 2m after a deploy tag.
Mateo: ack. I'll add deploy-aware logic to the canary evaluator.
Jordan: small TODO list before handoff:
- Priya: confirm rollback fully rolled (target hosts back to old routing) (PRIORITY)
- Mateo: run long-staging test + update canary config (in progress)
- Alex: prep prod dashboard tile and be ready to promote if staging green
- Maya: create the follow-up doc w/ thresholds, rationale, and rollback plan

Alex: taking the handoff at 1864512500. will monitor dashboards + throttle if anything regresses. ping me in #eng-oncall if anything escalates.
Jordan: thanks team. leaving with notes in the runbook: /runbooks/canary-response.md#1864512345. will update postmortem and add the exact thresholds. :white_check_mark:
